concepts.name: Ideal Gas Law
concepts.simple_definition: The Ideal Gas Law is the equation of state of a hypothetical ideal gas, given by PV = nRT.
concepts.deep_explanation: P is pressure, V is volume, n is number of moles, R is the universal gas constant, and T is temperature in Kelvin.
concepts.real_example: Heating a sealed gas cylinder increases T, which in turn increases pressure P since volume V is constant.
concepts.common_confusion: Forgetting to convert temperature to Kelvin (K) when using gas law calculations.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: የአይዲያል ጋዝ ሕግ የአንድን ጋዝ ባህሪ የሚገልጽ ቀመር ሲሆን PV = nRT ተብሎ ይገለጻል።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: P ግፊት፣ V ይዘት፣ n የሞል መጠን፣ R የጋዝ ኮንስታንት፣ እና T የሙቀት መጠን (በኬልቪን) ናቸው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የታሸገ ጋዝ ሲሊንደርን ማሞቅ T ን ይጨምራል፣ ይህም በምላሹ ግፊት P እንዲጨምር ያደርጋል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: የጋዝ ቀመሮችን ሲያሰሉ የሙቀት መጠንን ወደ ኬልቪን (K) መለወጥ መርሳት።
